interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to at least 6 feet of clear walking space to accommodate pedestrians and meet accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Tree Pit Reconfiguration
interventions.description: Relocate trees into a dedicated planting strip or furniture zone that serves as a buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Perimeter Landscaping
interventions.description: Replace the chain-link fence with high-quality landscaping or low-profile walls to improve the visual environment and pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe path for pedestrians and separate them from traffic.

interventions.title: Garage Exit Warning
interventions.description: Install visual or auditory warning signals at the garage exit to alert pedestrians of approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Tactile Warning Surfaces
interventions.description: Add truncated dome detectable warning tiles at the top and bottom of the ramp to improve accessibility and safety for visually impaired users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Install a sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Marking
interventions.description: Clearly mark the driveway area with high-visibility paint or textured pavement to alert both drivers and pedestrians to the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to a dedicated furniture zone or underground the utilities to clear the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Streetscape Greening and Active Frontage
interventions.description: Replace the chain-link fence with more permeable, attractive landscaping or encourage development that provides an active street edge.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to provide an accessible path of travel between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Encourage Transparent Fencing
interventions.description: Promote the use of more transparent or lower fencing to improve the visual connection between the private property and the public realm.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a buffer zone with planters or street furniture to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a marked crossing with signage to improve visibility and safety for those crossing the street.

interventions.title: Enhanced Buffer
interventions.description: Improve the sidewalk buffer with more consistent street trees or landscaping to increase separation from traffic.
